newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank seen selling markka for marks - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank seen selling markka for marks - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Finland was seen intervening in the foreign exchange market in early trade on Friday selling markka for German marks, forex dealers said.
"Yes they are in there, it is quite obvious," one dealer said.
A Bank of Finland declined to comment.
The markka firmed sharply against the German mark on Thursday and continued to strengthen on Friday. Dealers have said strong overseas buying boosted the Finnish unit.
At 1045/0845 GMT, the markka traded at 2.9775 per mark having come close to 2.9760. The markka ended at 2.9800 on Thursday. Earlier this week, DEM/FIM briefly traded above 3.00.
